# AWS deployment runbook

## 1. Required inputs

- Expected 12-digit AWS account ID.
- AWS region `eu-west-1`.
- GitHub repository in `owner/name` form and its immutable repository ID.
- AWS administrator credentials in CloudShell and GitHub repository-administrator access.
- MongoDB Atlas administrator access for the retained NAT EIP allowlist.
- OpenAI key, environment-scoped MongoDB URI, and Basic-auth password when storing secrets.

## 2. Complete CloudShell script

Paste this complete script into a mode-`700` file in AWS CloudShell. It embeds the reviewed Terraform setup resources and does not require a repository checkout.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077

TEMP_WORKSPACE=''
STANDALONE=false
SCRIPT_PATH="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/$(basename "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
TEMP_FILES=()
register_temp() { local item; for item in "$@"; do chmod 600 "$item"; TEMP_FILES+=("$item"); done; }
cleanup() { local item; for item in "${TEMP_FILES[@]:-}"; do rm -f -- "$item"; done; [[ -z "$TEMP_WORKSPACE" ]] || rm -rf -- "$TEMP_WORKSPACE"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

# BEGIN EMBEDDED_TERRAFORM
materialize_embedded_terraform() {
  local workspace manifest
  STANDALONE=true
  command -v base64 >/dev/null || die "Required command is unavailable: base64"
  command -v sha256sum >/dev/null || die "Required command is unavailable: sha256sum"

  manifest="$workspace/manifest.sha256"; : > "$manifest"; chmod 600 "$manifest"

  printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$workspace/infra/terraform/README.md"
  chmod 600 "$workspace/infra/terraform/README.md"

' '3e49efe043cf7d5310798e5278bd4b73132376799e7916cc9dcf7e5d66f3dfb2' 'infra/terraform/README.md' >> "$manifest"
  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/bootstrap"

  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/bootstrap"

  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/bootstrap"

  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/environment"

  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/environment"

  printf '%s  %s
' 'c1a025ad7b33bd70ff86ae9c52ad03ab8b7a704a4fbbb2bd65de520cbe96b47b' 'infra/terraform/modules/environment/ecs.tf' >> "$manifest"
  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/modules/environment"

  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/modules/environment"

' 'fa5f6ea7af58219fb84bb7593b26eec8b8f678bbcd7eb47cffcb782ed4adc51c' 'infra/terraform/modules/environment/storage.tf' >> "$manifest"
  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/modules/environment"
  printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$workspace/infra/terraform/modules/environment/variables.tf"

' 'dfee2ead1dbb66a5bdaaddf00a68d3fa58c40f4f415c0ee7bca35862fb12eea4' 'infra/terraform/modules/private-bucket/main.tf' >> "$manifest"
  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared"
  printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared/.terraform.lock.hcl"
  chmod 600 "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared/.terraform.lock.hcl"
  printf '%s  %s
' 'c62c0f6e8884aa30dfaf121a79f265bc34f787e35f9a169217cb86aefc9b5673' 'infra/terraform/shared/.terraform.lock.hcl' >> "$manifest"
  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared"
  printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared/main.tf"
  chmod 600 "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared/main.tf"
  printf '%s  %s
' '1e526cf887454b9a306b8d8299fee3e95b05a68ba4a1f964761851b4861f7574' 'infra/terraform/shared/main.tf' >> "$manifest"
  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared"
  printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared/network.tftest.hcl"
  chmod 600 "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared/network.tftest.hcl"
  printf '%s  %s
' '2b06144dd7de75d03522811586083a74cdd5640dcbe4172a09c423df747d774b' 'infra/terraform/shared/network.tftest.hcl' >> "$manifest"
  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared"
  printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared/variables.tf"
  chmod 600 "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared/variables.tf"
  printf '%s  %s

  mkdir -p "$workspace/infra/terraform/shared"

# END EMBEDDED_TERRAFORM

DEPLOY_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
DEPLOY_CONFIG="${DEPLOY_CONFIG:-$DEPLOY_ROOT/infra/config/deployment.env}"

load_config() {
  [[ -f "$DEPLOY_CONFIG" ]] || { echo "Copy infra/config/deployment.env.example to deployment.env and complete it." >&2; return 1; }
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  : # parsed configuration is already loaded
  : "${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID:?}" "${AWS_REGION:?}" "${PROJECT:?}" "${REPOSITORY:?}" "${REPOSITORY_ID:?}" "${REPOSITORY_OWNER_ID:?}"
  [[ "$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID" =~ ^[0-9]{12}$ ]] || { echo "AWS_ACCOUNT_ID must contain 12 digits." >&2; return 1; }
}

verify_identity() {
  local actual region
  actual="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)"
  region="$(aws configure get region || true)"
  [[ "$actual" == "$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID" ]] || { echo "Expected AWS account $AWS_ACCOUNT_ID, received $actual." >&2; return 1; }
  [[ -z "$region" || "$region" == "$AWS_REGION" ]] || { echo "Set the AWS CLI region to $AWS_REGION." >&2; return 1; }
}

prepare_bootstrap_inputs() {
  local file="$DEPLOY_ROOT/infra/terraform/bootstrap/bootstrap.auto.tfvars.json"
  [[ -f "$file" ]] && return
  if [[ -n "${OPERATIONS_BUCKET:-}" ]] && aws s3 cp "s3://$OPERATIONS_BUCKET/setup/bootstrap-inputs.json" "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then return; fi
  local oidc_arn=null services=() role service
  while read -r candidate; do
    [[ -n "$candidate" ]] || continue
    if [[ "$(aws iam get-open-id-connect-provider --open-id-connect-provider-arn "$candidate" --query Url --output text 2>/dev/null || true)" == "token.actions.githubusercontent.com" ]]; then oidc_arn="\"$candidate\""; break; fi
  done < <(aws iam list-open-id-connect-providers --query 'OpenIDConnectProviderList[].Arn' --output text | tr '\t' '\n')
  while IFS='|' read -r role service; do
    aws iam get-role --role-name "$role" >/dev/null 2>&1 || services+=("$service")
  done <<'ROLES'
AWSServiceRoleForECS|ecs.amazonaws.com
AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing|elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
AWSServiceRoleForCloudFrontVPCOrigin|vpcorigin.cloudfront.amazonaws.com
ROLES
  jq -n --argjson oidc "$oidc_arn" --argjson services "$(printf '%s\n' "${services[@]}" | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length>0))')" '{oidc_provider_arn:$oidc,create_service_linked_roles:$services}' > "$file"
}

stack_dir() {
  case "$1" in bootstrap|shared) printf '%s/infra/terraform/%s' "$DEPLOY_ROOT" "$1" ;; staging|prod) printf '%s/infra/terraform/environment' "$DEPLOY_ROOT" ;; *) echo "Stack must be bootstrap, shared, staging, or prod." >&2; return 1 ;; esac
}

environment_name() { [[ "$1" == "staging" ]] && printf '_staging' || [[ "$1" == "prod" ]] && printf '_prod' || return 1; }

terraform_args() {
  local stack="$1"
  printf '%s\n' "-var=aws_account_id=$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID" "-var=aws_region=$AWS_REGION" "-var=project=$PROJECT"
  if [[ "$stack" == "bootstrap" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "-var=repository=$REPOSITORY" "-var=repository_id=$REPOSITORY_ID" "-var=repository_owner_id=$REPOSITORY_OWNER_ID"; fi
  if [[ "$stack" == "staging" || "$stack" == "prod" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "-var=environment=$stack" "-var=state_bucket=$STATE_BUCKET"; fi
}

init_stack() {
  local stack="$1" directory; directory="$(stack_dir "$stack")"
  if [[ "$stack" == "bootstrap" ]]; then
    if [[ -n "${STATE_BUCKET:-}" ]]; then
      [[ -f "$directory/backend.generated.tf" ]] || printf 'terraform { backend "s3" {} }\n' > "$directory/backend.generated.tf"
      terraform -chdir="$directory" init -input=false -reconfigure -backend-config="bucket=$STATE_BUCKET" -backend-config="region=$AWS_REGION" -backend-config="key=$PROJECT/bootstrap.tfstate" -backend-config="use_lockfile=true"
    else terraform -chdir="$directory" init -input=false
    fi
  else : "${STATE_BUCKET:?Run bootstrap and set STATE_BUCKET first.}"; terraform -chdir="$directory" init -input=false -reconfigure -backend-config="bucket=$STATE_BUCKET" -backend-config="region=$AWS_REGION" -backend-config="key=$PROJECT/$stack.tfstate" -backend-config="use_lockfile=true"; fi
}

lock_operation() {
  verify_identity
  : "${OPERATIONS_BUCKET:?Run bootstrap and set OPERATIONS_BUCKET first.}"
  local action="${1:-status}"
  lock_key="operations/current.json"
  case "$action" in
    acquire)
      lock_file="$(mktemp)"; register_temp "$lock_file"
      printf '{"operation":"%s","environment":"%s","commit":"%s","run":"%s","step":"acquired","createdAt":"%s"}\n' "${OPERATION:?}" "${ENVIRONMENT:-shared}" "${GITHUB_SHA:-local}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-cloudshell}" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$lock_file"
      aws s3api put-object --bucket "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET" --key "$lock_key" --body "$lock_file" --content-type application/json --if-none-match '*' >/dev/null
      ;;
    update)
      local step="${2:?step}"; lock_file="$(mktemp)"; next_file="$(mktemp)"; register_temp "$lock_file" "$next_file"
      etag="$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET" --key "$lock_key" --query ETag --output text)"
      aws s3 cp "s3://$OPERATIONS_BUCKET/$lock_key" "$lock_file" >/dev/null
      jq --arg step "$step" --arg updatedAt "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" '.step=$step | .updatedAt=$updatedAt' "$lock_file" > "$next_file"
      aws s3api put-object --bucket "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET" --key "$lock_key" --body "$next_file" --content-type application/json --if-match "$etag" >/dev/null
      ;;
    release) aws s3api delete-object --bucket "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET" --key "$lock_key" --if-match "$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET" --key "$lock_key" --query ETag --output text)" >/dev/null ;;
    status) aws s3 cp "s3://$OPERATIONS_BUCKET/$lock_key" - 2>/dev/null || echo '{"status":"unlocked"}' ;;
    *) echo "Usage: operation-lock.sh acquire|update STEP|release|status" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
}

run_ecs_task() {
  : "${DEPLOYMENT_JSON:?Set DEPLOYMENT_JSON to the Terraform deployment output file.}"
  command_json="$(jq -cn --args '$ARGS.positional' -- "$@")"
  cluster="$(jq -r .cluster "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"
  task="$(jq -r .maintenance_task_definition "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"
  subnets="$(jq -r '.subnet_ids|join(",")' "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"
  groups="$(jq -r '.security_group_ids|join(",")' "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"
  container="$(jq -r .container_name "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"
  environment_json="$(jq -cn --arg backup "${BACKUP_ID:-}" --arg confirm "${CONFIRM_DATABASE:-}" --arg url "$(jq -r .url "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")" '[{name:"BACKUP_ID",value:$backup},{name:"CONFIRM_DATABASE",value:$confirm},{name:"DEPLOYMENT_URL",value:$url}]')"
  overrides="$(jq -cn --arg name "$container" --argjson command "$command_json" --argjson environment "$environment_json" '{containerOverrides:[{name:$name,command:$command,environment:$environment}]}')"
  task_arn="$(aws ecs run-task --cluster "$cluster" --task-definition "$task" --launch-type FARGATE --network-configuration "awsvpcConfiguration={subnets=[$subnets],securityGroups=[$groups],assignPublicIp=DISABLED}" --overrides "$overrides" --query 'tasks[0].taskArn' --output text)"
  [[ "$task_arn" != "None" ]] || { echo "ECS did not start the maintenance task." >&2; exit 1; }
  aws ecs wait tasks-stopped --cluster "$cluster" --tasks "$task_arn"
  exit_code="$(aws ecs describe-tasks --cluster "$cluster" --tasks "$task_arn" --query 'tasks[0].containers[0].exitCode' --output text)"
  [[ "$exit_code" == "0" ]] || { aws ecs describe-tasks --cluster "$cluster" --tasks "$task_arn"; exit 1; }
}

validate_plan() {
  local plan_json="${1:?plan JSON}" stack="${2:?stack}"
  jq -e . "$plan_json" >/dev/null
  deletions="$(jq -r '.resource_changes[]? | select(.change.actions | index("delete")) | [.type,.address] | @tsv' "$plan_json")"
  [[ -z "$deletions" ]] && return 0
  if [[ "${SETUP_MODE:-false}" == true ]]; then echo "Setup stopped because the plan contains deletions." >&2; printf '%s\n' "$deletions" >&2; return 1; fi
  if [[ "$stack" == "bootstrap" && "${ALLOW_BOOTSTRAP_SECURITY_CHANGE:-false}" != "true" ]]; then
    echo "Bootstrap security deletions require an exceptional administrator operation." >&2; printf '%s\n' "$deletions" >&2; exit 1
  fi
  if grep -Eq '^aws_(s3_bucket|eip|secretsmanager_secret|wafv2_web_acl|iam_)' <<<"$deletions"; then
    echo "The plan deletes protected storage, the retained NAT EIP, secrets, WAF, or IAM controls." >&2
    printf '%s\n' "$deletions" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

configure_github() {
  : "${STATE_BUCKET:?}" "${OPERATIONS_BUCKET:?}"

  branch_protection() {
    local branch="$1"
    gh api --method PUT -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "repos/$REPOSITORY/branches/$branch/protection" --input - <<JSON
  {"required_status_checks":{"strict":true,"contexts":["Validate / validate"]},"enforce_admins":true,"required_pull_request_reviews":{"dismiss_stale_reviews":true,"required_approving_review_count":1},"restrictions":null,"required_linear_history":true,"allow_force_pushes":false,"allow_deletions":false,"required_conversation_resolution":true}
JSON
  }

  set_environment_variable() {
    local environment="$1" name="$2" value="$3"
    gh api --method POST -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "repositories/$REPOSITORY_ID/environments/$environment/variables" -f name="$name" -f value="$value" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
      || gh api --method PATCH -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "repositories/$REPOSITORY_ID/environments/$environment/variables/$name" -f name="$name" -f value="$value" >/dev/null
  }

  # Preserve unrelated OIDC configuration. An incompatible template is reported and
  # must be reviewed because replacing it can break other repository integrations.
  claims='["repository_id","repository_owner_id","ref","context","job_workflow_ref"]'
  existing="$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/actions/oidc/customization/sub" --jq '.include_claim_keys // [] | @json')"
  if [[ "$existing" != "[]" && "$existing" != "$claims" ]]; then
    echo "The repository has an incompatible OIDC subject template: $existing" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ "$existing" == "[]" ]]; then
    gh api --method PUT "repos/$REPOSITORY/actions/oidc/customization/sub" --input - <<JSON
  {"use_default":false,"include_claim_keys":$claims}
JSON
  fi

  for environment in _shared _staging _prod; do
    gh api --method PUT "repos/$REPOSITORY/environments/$environment" --input - <<'JSON' >/dev/null
  {"deployment_branch_policy":{"protected_branches":true,"custom_branch_policies":false}}
JSON
  done

  bootstrap_json="$(terraform -chdir="$DEPLOY_ROOT/infra/terraform/bootstrap" output -json)"
  for stack in shared staging prod; do
    environment="_$stack"
    set_environment_variable "$environment" AWS_ACCOUNT_ID "$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID"
    set_environment_variable "$environment" STATE_BUCKET "$STATE_BUCKET"
    set_environment_variable "$environment" OPERATIONS_BUCKET "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET"
    roles=(plan apply); [[ "$stack" == "shared" ]] || roles+=(release maintenance)
    for role in "${roles[@]}"; do
      role_key="$stack-$role"
      role_arn="$(jq -r --arg key "$role_key" '.roles.value[$key]' <<<"$bootstrap_json")"
      set_environment_variable "$environment" "AWS_${role^^}_ROLE_ARN" "$role_arn"
    done
    if [[ "$stack" != "shared" ]] && aws s3api head-object --bucket "$STATE_BUCKET" --key "$PROJECT/$stack.tfstate" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      init_stack "$stack"
      repository_url="$(terraform -chdir="$(stack_dir "$stack")" output -json deployment | jq -r .repository_url)"
      set_environment_variable "$environment" ECR_REPOSITORY_URL "$repository_url"
    fi
  done

  for branch in master _staging _prod; do
    if gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/branches/$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch_protection "$branch"; fi
  done
  echo "GitHub environments, variables, branch protections, and the OIDC subject template are configured."
}

configuration_pr() {
  : "${STATE_BUCKET:?}" "${OPERATIONS_BUCKET:?}"
  branch="agent/issue-24-deployment-configuration"
  base_sha="$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/master" --jq .object.sha)"
  gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || gh api --method POST "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$branch" -f sha="$base_sha" >/dev/null
  document="$(jq -cn --arg account "$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID" --arg region "$AWS_REGION" --arg state "$STATE_BUCKET" --arg operations "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET" --arg commit "$base_sha" '{schemaVersion:"1",awsAccountId:$account,awsRegion:$region,stateBucket:$state,operationsBucket:$operations,reviewedCommit:$commit}')"
  content="$(printf '%s\n' "$document" | base64 -w0)"
  current_sha="$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/infra/config/configured.json?ref=$branch" --jq .sha 2>/dev/null || true)"
  arguments=(--method PUT "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/infra/config/configured.json" -f message="Configure AWS deployment account" -f content="$content" -f branch="$branch")
  [[ -z "$current_sha" ]] || arguments+=(-f sha="$current_sha")
  gh api "${arguments[@]}" >/dev/null
  gh pr view "$branch" --repo "$REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || gh pr create --repo "$REPOSITORY" --base master --head "$branch" --title "Configure AWS deployment account" --body "Records the non-secret AWS account, region, state bucket, operations bucket, and reviewed setup commit. Merge this PR before creating the deployment branches." >/dev/null
  echo "Configuration PR created or updated. Merge it after review, then run aws-deployment.sh --action finalize with the same identity arguments and --apply"
}

finalize_setup() {
  master_sha="$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/master" --jq .object.sha)"
  configuration="$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/infra/config/configured.json?ref=master" --jq .content | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d)"
  jq -e --arg account "$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID" --arg region "$AWS_REGION" --arg state "$STATE_BUCKET" --arg operations "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET" '.awsAccountId==$account and .awsRegion==$region and .stateBucket==$state and .operationsBucket==$operations' <<<"$configuration" >/dev/null \
    || { echo "The merged configuration does not match this setup." >&2; exit 1; }
  for branch in _staging _prod; do
    gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
      || gh api --method POST "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$branch" -f sha="$master_sha" >/dev/null
  done
  configure_github
  checkpoint="$(mktemp)"; register_temp "$checkpoint"
  jq -cn --arg commit "$master_sha" --arg at "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" '{schemaVersion:"1",status:"verified",configuredCommit:$commit,updatedAt:$at}' > "$checkpoint"
  aws s3api put-object --bucket "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET" --key setup/status.json --body "$checkpoint" --content-type application/json >/dev/null
  echo "Setup is verified. Deployment branches exist and were not reset."
}

release_operation() {
  : "${STACK:?}" "${MODE:?}"
  init_stack "$STACK"; mkdir -p "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy"
  directory="$(stack_dir "$STACK")"
  terraform -chdir="$directory" output -json deployment > "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/deployment.json"
  export DEPLOYMENT_JSON="$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/deployment.json"
  cluster="$(jq -r .cluster "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"; service="$(jq -r .service "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"

  case "$MODE" in
    prepare)
      description="$(aws ecs describe-services --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service" --query 'services[0]' --output json)"
      previous=""; if [[ "$(jq -r '.desiredCount // 0' <<<"$description")" -gt 0 ]]; then previous="$(jq -r '.taskDefinition // ""' <<<"$description")"; fi
      if [[ "$STACK" == "staging" && "$(jq -r '.desiredCount // 0' <<<"$description")" -eq 0 ]]; then
        aws s3api head-object --bucket "$(jq -r .buckets.recovery "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")" --key migration/verified.json >/dev/null \
          || { echo "First staging activation requires a verified asset migration." >&2; exit 1; }
      fi
      echo "previous=$previous" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:-/dev/null}"
      if [[ "$(jq -r '.desiredCount // 0' <<<"$description")" -gt 0 ]]; then
        lock_operation update preparing
        run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts enable "GitHub deployment ${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}"
        run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/wait-for-deployment-drain.ts
        aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 0 >/dev/null
        aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
        run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/recovery.ts backup
      fi
      ;;
    register-app)
      : "${IMAGE_URI:?}"
      jq --arg image "$IMAGE_URI" '.task_definition_template.containerDefinitions[0].image=$image | .task_definition_template.containerDefinitions[0].environment += [{name:"RELEASE_IMAGE_DIGEST",value:$image}]' "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON" > "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/task-definition.json"
      revision="$(aws ecs register-task-definition --cli-input-json "file://$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/task-definition.json" --query 'taskDefinition.taskDefinitionArn' --output text)"
      echo "revision=$revision" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:-/dev/null}"
      ;;
    register-maintenance)
      : "${IMAGE_URI:?}"
      jq --arg image "$IMAGE_URI" '.maintenance_task_definition_template.containerDefinitions[0].image=$image | .maintenance_task_definition_template.containerDefinitions[0].environment += [{name:"RELEASE_IMAGE_DIGEST",value:$image}]' "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON" > "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/maintenance-task-definition.json"
      revision="$(aws ecs register-task-definition --cli-input-json "file://$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/maintenance-task-definition.json" --query 'taskDefinition.taskDefinitionArn' --output text)"
      echo "revision=$revision" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:-/dev/null}"
      ;;
    activate)
      : "${APP_TASK_DEFINITION:?}" "${MAINTENANCE_TASK_DEFINITION:?}"
      jq --arg revision "$MAINTENANCE_TASK_DEFINITION" '.maintenance_task_definition=$revision' "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON" > "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/deployment.next.json"
      mv "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/deployment.next.json" "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON"
      lock_operation update initializing
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/initialize-deployment.ts
      rollback_previous() {
        set +e
        if [[ -n "${PREVIOUS_TASK_DEFINITION:-}" ]]; then
          aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --task-definition "$PREVIOUS_TASK_DEFINITION" --desired-count 1 >/dev/null
          if aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service" \
            && run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/check-deployment-readiness.ts; then
            run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts disable
          fi
        else
          aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 0 >/dev/null
        fi
        echo "Release verification failed. Maintenance and the operation lock remain active." >&2
      }
      trap rollback_previous ERR
      aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --task-definition "$APP_TASK_DEFINITION" --desired-count 1 --force-new-deployment >/dev/null
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      url="$(jq -r .url "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"
      curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 12 --retry-delay 10 "$url/api/health/live" >/dev/null
      test "$(curl --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url/")" = "401"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/check-deployment-readiness.ts
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts disable
      lock_operation update verified
      trap - ERR
      ;;
    *) echo "MODE must be prepare, register-app, register-maintenance, or activate." >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
}

maintenance_operation() {
  : "${STACK:?}" "${ACTION:?}"
  init_stack "$STACK"
  terraform -chdir="$(stack_dir "$STACK")" output -json deployment > "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/deployment.json"
  export DEPLOYMENT_JSON="$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/deployment.json"
  cluster="$(jq -r .cluster "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"; service="$(jq -r .service "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"

  case "$ACTION" in
    drain-shared)
      if [[ "${LOCK_HELD:-false}" != "true" ]]; then lock_operation acquire; fi
      desired="$(aws ecs describe-services --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service" --query 'services[0].desiredCount' --output text)"
      checkpoint="$(mktemp)"; register_temp "$checkpoint"
      jq -n --argjson desired "$desired" '{desiredCount:$desired}' > "$checkpoint"
      aws s3 cp "$checkpoint" "s3://$OPERATIONS_BUCKET/operations/shared-drain/$STACK.json" >/dev/null
      if [[ "$desired" -gt 0 ]]; then
        run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts enable "shared infrastructure change"
        run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/wait-for-deployment-drain.ts
        aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 0 >/dev/null
        aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      fi
      ;;
    restart-shared)
      checkpoint="$(aws s3 cp "s3://$OPERATIONS_BUCKET/operations/shared-drain/$STACK.json" -)"
      if [[ "$(jq -r .desiredCount <<<"$checkpoint")" -gt 0 ]]; then
        aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 1 >/dev/null
        aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
        run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/check-deployment-readiness.ts
        run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts disable
      fi
      aws s3 rm "s3://$OPERATIONS_BUCKET/operations/shared-drain/$STACK.json" >/dev/null
      if [[ "${RELEASE_LOCK:-false}" == "true" ]]; then lock_operation release; fi
      ;;
    check)
      curl --fail --silent --show-error "$(jq -r .url "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")/api/health/live"
      test "$(curl --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "$(jq -r .url "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")/")" = "401"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/check-deployment-readiness.ts
      ;;
    backup)
      lock_operation acquire
      lock_operation update draining
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts enable "manual backup"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/wait-for-deployment-drain.ts
      aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 0 >/dev/null
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/recovery.ts backup
      aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 1 >/dev/null
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/check-deployment-readiness.ts
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts disable
      lock_operation release
      ;;
    restore)
      : "${BACKUP_ID:?}" "${CONFIRM_DATABASE:?}"
      lock_operation acquire
      lock_operation update draining
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts enable "database restore"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/wait-for-deployment-drain.ts
      aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 0 >/dev/null
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      BACKUP_ID="$BACKUP_ID" CONFIRM_DATABASE="$CONFIRM_DATABASE" run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/recovery.ts restore
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/initialize-deployment.ts
      aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 1 >/dev/null
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/check-deployment-readiness.ts
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts disable
      lock_operation release
      ;;
    rollback)
      : "${TASK_DEFINITION:?Provide an exact prior task-definition ARN.}"
      [[ "$TASK_DEFINITION" =~ ^arn:aws:ecs:${AWS_REGION}:${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:task-definition/${PROJECT}-${STACK}:[0-9]+$ ]] || die "Rollback task definition does not belong to this account, region, environment, and application family"
      rollback_image="$(aws ecs describe-task-definition --task-definition "$TASK_DEFINITION" --query 'taskDefinition.containerDefinitions[?name==`application`].image | [0]' --output text)"
      [[ -n "$rollback_image" && "$rollback_image" != *':bootstrap-unpublished' ]] || die "Rollback cannot start the unpublished bootstrap revision"
      lock_operation acquire
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts enable "application rollback"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/wait-for-deployment-drain.ts
      aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 0 >/dev/null
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --task-definition "$TASK_DEFINITION" --desired-count 1 >/dev/null
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/check-deployment-readiness.ts
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts disable
      lock_operation release
      ;;
    reset-staging)
      [[ "$STACK" == "staging" && "${CONFIRM_DATABASE:-}" == "kids_booklet" ]] || { echo "Reset requires staging and CONFIRM_DATABASE=kids_booklet." >&2; exit 1; }
      lock_operation acquire
      lock_operation update draining
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts enable "staging reset"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/wait-for-deployment-drain.ts
      aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 0 >/dev/null
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/recovery.ts backup
      CONFIRM_DATABASE="$CONFIRM_DATABASE" run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/reset-staging-deployment.ts
      aws ecs update-service --cluster "$cluster" --service "$service" --desired-count 1 >/dev/null
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/check-deployment-readiness.ts
      run_ecs_task ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/deployment-control.ts disable
      lock_operation release
      ;;
    resume)
      lock_json="$(aws s3 cp "s3://$OPERATIONS_BUCKET/operations/current.json" -)"
      [[ "$(jq -r .environment <<<"$lock_json")" == "_$STACK" ]] || { echo "The recorded lock belongs to another environment." >&2; exit 1; }
      recorded_run="$(jq -r .run <<<"$lock_json")"
      if [[ "$recorded_run" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        [[ "$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$recorded_run" --jq .status)" == "completed" ]] || { echo "The recorded workflow is still active." >&2; exit 1; }
      fi
      family="$(jq -r '.maintenance_task_definition | split("/")[-1] | split(":")[0]' "$DEPLOYMENT_JSON")"
      test "$(aws ecs list-tasks --cluster "$cluster" --family "$family" --desired-status RUNNING --query 'length(taskArns)' --output text)" = "0"
      aws ecs wait services-stable --cluster "$cluster" --services "$service"
      lock_operation release
      ;;
    *) echo "Unknown maintenance action." >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
}



usage() {
  cat <<'USAGE'
Usage: aws-deployment.sh --action ACTION --account-id ID --region eu-west-1 [options] [--apply]
Actions: status, setup, finalize, secrets, infrastructure, lock, release, maintenance.
Options: --repository OWNER/NAME --repository-id ID --project NAME --stack STACK
         --environment staging|prod --step STEP --backup-id ID --confirmation VALUE
         --task-definition ARN --image-uri URI --previous-task-definition ARN
         --app-task-definition ARN --maintenance-task-definition ARN --lock-held
         --release-lock --apply --help
Preview is the default. Mutating actions require --apply.
USAGE
}

die() { printf 'Error: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
set_arg() { local name="$1" old="$2" value="$3"; [[ -z "$old" || "$old" == "$value" ]] || die "$name has conflicting values"; printf -v "$name" '%s' "$value"; }
need_value() { [[ $# -gt 1 && "$2" != --* ]] || die "$1 requires a value"; }

parse_arguments() {
  ACTION=''; APPLY=false; AWS_ACCOUNT_ID=''; AWS_REGION=''; PROJECT='kids-booklet'; REPOSITORY=''; REPOSITORY_ID=''; REPOSITORY_OWNER_ID=''; STATE_BUCKET=''; OPERATIONS_BUCKET=''; STACK=''; ENVIRONMENT=''; STEP=''; BACKUP_ID=''; CONFIRMATION=''; TASK_DEFINITION=''; IMAGE_URI=''; PREVIOUS_TASK_DEFINITION=''; APP_TASK_DEFINITION=''; MAINTENANCE_TASK_DEFINITION=''; LOCK_HELD=false; RELEASE_LOCK=false
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --project) need_value "$@"; PROJECT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --account-id) need_value "$@"; set_arg AWS_ACCOUNT_ID "$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID" "$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --region) need_value "$@"; set_arg AWS_REGION "$AWS_REGION" "$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --action|--repository|--repository-id|--stack|--environment|--step|--backup-id|--confirmation|--task-definition|--image-uri|--previous-task-definition|--app-task-definition|--maintenance-task-definition)
        need_value "$@"; local key="${1#--}"; key="${key^^}"; key="${key//-/_}"; set_arg "$key" "${!key:-}" "$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --apply) APPLY=true; shift ;; --lock-held) LOCK_HELD=true; shift ;; --release-lock) RELEASE_LOCK=true; shift ;;
      --help) usage; exit 0 ;; --*) die "Unknown argument: $1" ;; *) die "Positional argument rejected: $1" ;;
    esac
  done
}

load_named_config() {
  DEPLOY_CONFIG="${DEPLOY_CONFIG:-$DEPLOY_ROOT/infra/config/deployment.env}"
  if [[ -f "$DEPLOY_CONFIG" ]]; then
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
      [[ "$key" =~ ^(AWS_ACCOUNT_ID|AWS_REGION|PROJECT|REPOSITORY|REPOSITORY_ID|REPOSITORY_OWNER_ID|STATE_BUCKET|OPERATIONS_BUCKET)$ ]] || continue
      [[ -n "${!key:-}" ]] || printf -v "$key" '%s' "$value"
    done < "$DEPLOY_CONFIG"
  fi
}

validate_cli() {
  [[ "$ACTION" =~ ^(status|setup|finalize|secrets|infrastructure|lock|release|maintenance)$ ]] || die '--action is required and must be valid'
  [[ "$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID" =~ ^[0-9]{12}$ ]] || die '--account-id must contain 12 digits'
  [[ "$AWS_REGION" == eu-west-1 ]] || die '--region must be eu-west-1'
  [[ "$ACTION" != status || "$APPLY" == false ]] || die '--apply is invalid for status'; [[ "$ACTION" != lock || "$STEP" != status || "$APPLY" == false ]] || die '--apply is invalid for lock status'
  case "$ACTION" in
    setup|finalize) [[ "$REPOSITORY" =~ ^[^/]+/[^/]+$ && -n "$REPOSITORY_ID" ]] || die 'GitHub setup requires --repository and --repository-id' ;;
    infrastructure) [[ "$STACK" =~ ^(bootstrap|shared|staging|prod)$ ]] || die 'Infrastructure requires --stack'; [[ "$STACK" != bootstrap || "$REPOSITORY" =~ ^[^/]+/[^/]+$ && -n "$REPOSITORY_ID" ]] || die 'Bootstrap requires --repository and --repository-id' ;;
    secrets) [[ "$ENVIRONMENT" =~ ^(staging|prod)$ ]] || die 'Secrets require --environment' ;;
    lock) [[ "$STEP" =~ ^(acquire|update|release|status)$ ]] || die 'Lock requires --step' ;;
    release) [[ "$ENVIRONMENT" =~ ^(staging|prod)$ && "$STEP" =~ ^(prepare|register-app|register-maintenance|activate)$ ]] || die 'Release arguments are invalid' ;;
    maintenance) [[ "$ENVIRONMENT" =~ ^(staging|prod)$ && "$STEP" =~ ^(drain-shared|restart-shared|check|backup|restore|rollback|reset-staging|resume)$ ]] || die 'Maintenance arguments are invalid' ;;
  esac
  [[ "$STEP" != restore || -n "$BACKUP_ID" && -n "$CONFIRMATION" ]] || die 'Restore requires --backup-id and --confirmation'
  [[ "$STEP" != rollback || -n "$TASK_DEFINITION" ]] || die 'Rollback requires --task-definition'
  [[ "$STEP" != reset-staging || "$ENVIRONMENT" == staging && "$CONFIRMATION" == kids_booklet ]] || die 'Reset requires staging confirmation'
  [[ "$STEP" != register-app && "$STEP" != register-maintenance || -n "$IMAGE_URI" ]] || die 'Registration requires --image-uri'
  [[ "$STEP" != activate || -n "$APP_TASK_DEFINITION" && -n "$MAINTENANCE_TASK_DEFINITION" ]] || die 'Activation requires both task definitions'
}

verify_identity() {
  command -v aws >/dev/null || die 'Required command is unavailable: aws'
  command -v jq >/dev/null || die 'Required command is unavailable: jq'
  local actual configured
  actual="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)" || die 'AWS credentials are unavailable'
  [[ "$actual" == "$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID" ]] || die "Expected AWS account $AWS_ACCOUNT_ID, received $actual"
  configured="$(aws configure get region 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -z "$configured" || "$configured" == "$AWS_REGION" ]] || die "AWS CLI region is $configured"
  export AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="$AWS_REGION"
}

preview_or_apply() { [[ "$APPLY" == true ]] && printf 'Mode: apply\n' || printf 'Mode: preview\n'; }

resolve_repository_owner() {
  gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'GitHub authentication is required before setup preview; run gh auth login and retry'
  [[ "$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY" --jq .permissions.admin)" == true ]] || die 'GitHub repository administration is required'
  REPOSITORY_OWNER_ID="$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY" --jq .owner.id)"
  [[ "$REPOSITORY_OWNER_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die 'GitHub returned an invalid repository owner ID'
}

install_tools() {
  local tools="$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/tools" terraform_version=1.11.4 gh_version=2.78.0
  mkdir -p "$tools/bin"; chmod 700 "$tools" "$tools/bin"
  if [[ ! -x "$tools/bin/terraform" ]]; then
    command -v curl >/dev/null || die 'Required command is unavailable: curl'; command -v unzip >/dev/null || die 'Required command is unavailable: unzip'
    curl -fsSLo "$tools/terraform.zip" "https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/$terraform_version/terraform_${terraform_version}_linux_amd64.zip"
    curl -fsSLo "$tools/terraform.sha256" "https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/$terraform_version/terraform_${terraform_version}_SHA256SUMS"
    (cd "$tools" && grep "terraform_${terraform_version}_linux_amd64.zip" terraform.sha256 | sha256sum -c - && unzip -oq terraform.zip -d bin)
  fi
  if [[ ! -x "$tools/bin/gh" ]]; then
    command -v curl >/dev/null || die 'Required command is unavailable: curl'; command -v tar >/dev/null || die 'Required command is unavailable: tar'
    curl -fsSLo "$tools/gh.tar.gz" "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v$gh_version/gh_${gh_version}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
    curl -fsSLo "$tools/gh.sha256" "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v$gh_version/gh_${gh_version}_checksums.txt"
    (cd "$tools" && grep "gh_${gh_version}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" gh.sha256 | sha256sum -c - && tar -xzf gh.tar.gz && cp "gh_${gh_version}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" bin/gh)
  fi
  export PATH="$tools/bin:$PATH"
}
review_directory() { printf '%s/.kids-booklet-deployment/%s/%s/plans' "${HOME:?}" "$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID" "$PROJECT"; }
persist_reviewed_plan() {
  [[ "$STANDALONE" == true ]] || return 0
  local directory manifest plan_json plan_file
  directory="$(review_directory)"; mkdir -p "$directory"; chmod 700 "$directory"
  plan_file="$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan"; plan_json="$plan_file.json"; manifest="$directory/$STACK.manifest"
  cp "$plan_file" "$directory/$STACK.tfplan"; cp "$plan_json" "$directory/$STACK.tfplan.json"; chmod 600 "$directory/$STACK.tfplan" "$directory/$STACK.tfplan.json"
  jq -n --arg script "$(sha256sum "$SCRIPT_PATH" | cut -d' ' -f1)" --arg plan "$(sha256sum "$plan_file" | cut -d' ' -f1)" --arg json "$(sha256sum "$plan_json" | cut -d' ' -f1)" '{script:$script,plan:$plan,json:$json}' > "$manifest"; chmod 600 "$manifest"
  printf 'exists: reviewed plan saved at %s\n' "$directory/$STACK.tfplan"
}
restore_reviewed_plan() {
  [[ "$STANDALONE" == true ]] || return 0
  local directory manifest expected actual
  directory="$(review_directory)"; manifest="$directory/$STACK.manifest"
  [[ -f "$manifest" && -f "$directory/$STACK.tfplan" && -f "$directory/$STACK.tfplan.json" ]] || die "No reviewed $STACK plan exists; run preview first"
  expected="$(jq -r .script "$manifest")"; actual="$(sha256sum "$SCRIPT_PATH" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || die 'The script differs from the reviewed-plan script'
  expected="$(jq -r .plan "$manifest")"; actual="$(sha256sum "$directory/$STACK.tfplan" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || die 'The reviewed plan checksum is invalid'
  expected="$(jq -r .json "$manifest")"; actual="$(sha256sum "$directory/$STACK.tfplan.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || die 'The reviewed plan JSON checksum is invalid'
  cp "$directory/$STACK.tfplan" "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan"; cp "$directory/$STACK.tfplan.json" "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan.json"; chmod 600 "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan" "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan.json"
}
run_infrastructure() {
  local stack="$1" directory acquired=false; STACK="$stack"; init_stack "$STACK"; mkdir -p "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans"; directory="$(stack_dir "$STACK")"
  mapfile -t variables < <(terraform_args "$STACK")
  [[ "$APPLY" == false ]] || restore_reviewed_plan
  if [[ "$APPLY" == false || ! -f "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan" ]]; then
    terraform -chdir="$directory" plan -input=false -lock-timeout=5m "${variables[@]}" -out="$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan"
    terraform -chdir="$directory" show -json "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan" > "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan.json"
  fi
  validate_plan "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan.json" "$STACK"
  create_count="$(jq '[.resource_changes[]? | select(.change.actions == ["create"])] | length' "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan.json")"
  update_count="$(jq '[.resource_changes[]? | select(.change.actions | index("update"))] | length' "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan.json")"
  if [[ "$APPLY" == false ]]; then persist_reviewed_plan; [[ "$create_count" -eq 0 ]] || printf 'would create: %s resources in %s\n' "$create_count" "$STACK"; [[ "$update_count" -eq 0 ]] || printf 'would update: %s resources in %s\n' "$update_count" "$STACK"; [[ "$create_count" -ne 0 || "$update_count" -ne 0 ]] || printf 'exists: Terraform stack %s is unchanged\n' "$STACK"; return; fi
  if [[ -f "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.manifest.sha256" ]]; then (cd "$DEPLOY_ROOT" && sha256sum -c ".deploy/plans/$STACK.manifest.sha256"); fi
  if [[ "$STACK" != bootstrap && "${LOCK_HELD:-false}" != true ]]; then OPERATION="terraform-apply-$STACK" ENVIRONMENT="$STACK" lock_operation acquire; acquired=true; fi
  terraform -chdir="$directory" apply -input=false "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.deploy/plans/$STACK.tfplan"
  if [[ "$STACK" == bootstrap && -z "$STATE_BUCKET" ]]; then
    STATE_BUCKET="$(terraform -chdir="$directory" output -raw state_bucket)"; OPERATIONS_BUCKET="$(terraform -chdir="$directory" output -raw operations_bucket)"
    printf 'terraform { backend "s3" {} }\n' > "$directory/backend.generated.tf"; chmod 600 "$directory/backend.generated.tf"
    terraform -chdir="$directory" init -input=false -migrate-state -force-copy -backend-config="bucket=$STATE_BUCKET" -backend-config="region=$AWS_REGION" -backend-config="key=$PROJECT/bootstrap.tfstate" -backend-config="use_lockfile=true"
    aws s3 cp "$directory/bootstrap.auto.tfvars.json" "s3://$OPERATIONS_BUCKET/setup/bootstrap-inputs.json" >/dev/null
  fi
  [[ "$acquired" == false ]] || lock_operation release; terraform -chdir="$directory" state list >/dev/null; if [[ "$create_count" -gt 0 ]]; then printf 'created: %s resources in %s (state verified)\n' "$create_count" "$STACK"; else printf 'updated: Terraform stack %s (state verified)\n' "$STACK"; fi
}
run_setup() {
  install_tools
  if ! gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ "$APPLY" == true ]]; then gh auth login --web --git-protocol https; fi
  resolve_repository_owner
  SETUP_MODE=true; prepare_bootstrap_inputs
  next_stack=bootstrap
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$PROJECT-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID-state" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    STATE_BUCKET="$PROJECT-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID-state"; OPERATIONS_BUCKET="$PROJECT-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID-operations"; next_stack=shared
    aws s3api head-object --bucket "$STATE_BUCKET" --key "$PROJECT/shared.tfstate" >/dev/null 2>&1 && next_stack=staging
    aws s3api head-object --bucket "$STATE_BUCKET" --key "$PROJECT/staging.tfstate" >/dev/null 2>&1 && next_stack=prod
    aws s3api head-object --bucket "$STATE_BUCKET" --key "$PROJECT/prod.tfstate" >/dev/null 2>&1 && next_stack=complete
  fi
  if [[ "$next_stack" != complete ]]; then run_infrastructure "$next_stack"; printf 'exists: setup checkpoint completed through %s; rerun preview for the next checkpoint\n' "$next_stack"; return; fi
  if [[ "$APPLY" == false ]]; then printf 'would update: compatible GitHub OIDC, environments, variables, branch protection, and configuration PR\n'; return; fi
  configure_github; configuration_pr
  printf 'updated: AWS infrastructure exists and GitHub configuration is verified; complete Atlas access and merge the configuration PR before finalize\n'
}
main() {
  parse_arguments "$@"; load_named_config; validate_cli; preview_or_apply; verify_identity; if [[ ! -d "$DEPLOY_ROOT/infra/terraform" ]]; then materialize_embedded_terraform; fi; if [[ -z "$STATE_BUCKET" ]] && aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$PROJECT-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID-state" >/dev/null 2>&1; then STATE_BUCKET="$PROJECT-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID-state"; OPERATIONS_BUCKET="$PROJECT-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID-operations"; fi
  case "$ACTION" in
    status) aws sts get-caller-identity --query '{Account:Account,Arn:Arn}' --output json; [[ -z "$OPERATIONS_BUCKET" ]] || lock_operation status ;;
    infrastructure) install_tools; if [[ "$STACK" == bootstrap ]]; then command -v gh >/dev/null || die "GitHub CLI is required for bootstrap"; resolve_repository_owner; fi; run_infrastructure "$STACK" ;;
    setup) run_setup ;;
    finalize) install_tools; gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "GitHub authentication is required"; REPOSITORY_OWNER_ID="$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY" --jq .owner.id)"; init_stack bootstrap; [[ "$APPLY" == true ]] || { printf 'would create: missing deployment branches and setup checkpoint\n'; return; }; finalize_setup ;;
    secrets) [[ "$APPLY" == true ]] || { printf 'would update: secret values for %s\n' "$ENVIRONMENT"; return; }; for secret in OPENAI_API_KEY MONGODB_URI ACCESS_GATE_PASSWORD; do read -rsp "Value for _$ENVIRONMENT $secret: " value; printf '\n'; printf %s "$value" | aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id "$PROJECT/$ENVIRONMENT/$secret" --secret-string file:///dev/stdin >/dev/null; unset value; printf 'updated: %s\n' "$secret"; done ;;
    lock) [[ -z "$ENVIRONMENT" ]] || ENVIRONMENT="_$ENVIRONMENT"; [[ "$STEP" == status || "$APPLY" == true ]] || { printf 'would update: operation lock %s\n' "$STEP"; return; }; lock_operation "$STEP" ;;
    release) [[ "$APPLY" == true ]] || { printf 'would update: release %s\n' "$STEP"; return; }; STACK="$ENVIRONMENT" MODE="$STEP" release_operation ;;
    maintenance) [[ "$APPLY" == true ]] || { printf 'would update: maintenance %s\n' "$STEP"; return; }; STACK="$ENVIRONMENT"; ENVIRONMENT="_$ENVIRONMENT"; ACTION="$STEP"; CONFIRM_DATABASE="$CONFIRMATION"; maintenance_operation ;;
  esac
}

if [[ "${AWS_DEPLOYMENT_LIBRARY_ONLY:-false}" != true ]]; then main "$@"; fi
```

## 3. Preview and apply examples

Preview the full one-time setup from CloudShell:

```bash
./aws-deployment.sh --action setup --account-id 123456789012 --region eu-west-1 \
  --repository karpishe-experiments/agentic-poc --repository-id 1304721239
```

Apply only after reviewing the preview and Terraform plan:

```bash
./aws-deployment.sh --action setup --account-id 123456789012 --region eu-west-1 \
  --repository karpishe-experiments/agentic-poc --repository-id 1304721239 --apply
```

After Atlas access is configured and the configuration PR is merged:

```bash
./aws-deployment.sh --action finalize --account-id 123456789012 --region eu-west-1 \
  --repository karpishe-experiments/agentic-poc --repository-id 1304721239 --apply
```

## 4. Expected results and recovery notes

Preview performs discovery and Terraform planning and reports `exists`, `would create`, or `would update`. Apply creates or updates compatible resources, verifies sanitized state, and reports `created` or `updated`. Setup advances through one reviewed checkpoint at a time: bootstrap, shared, staging, production, and GitHub configuration. Run preview and then apply for each checkpoint. This preserves the exact checksum-bound reviewed plan between invocations. Services remain at desired count zero until a release workflow deploys an immutable image digest.

Setup is additive. It does not delete resources or roll back automatically. It stops on account or region mismatch, incompatible OIDC configuration, destructive Terraform changes, retained NAT EIP replacement, or ambiguous ownership. Temporary Terraform files use mode `600` and are removed on exit. Setup checkpoints and Terraform state remain in AWS.

If setup stops, rerun preview with the same arguments. Reviewed plans are stored with mode `600` under `~/.kids-booklet-deployment/<account>/<project>/plans`; apply rejects a changed script, plan, or plan JSON. Inspect the reported checkpoint and drift before using `--apply`. Never remove the S3 operation lock manually. For failed GitHub operations, verify that the workflow and maintenance task stopped, then use **Maintenance -> Resume**. Explicit backup, restore, application rollback, and guarded staging reset remain GitHub maintenance operations; database restore is never automatic.

Before first staging activation, allow the retained NAT EIP in Atlas, use separate database users, migrate and verify local staging assets, prove transaction support and S3 access, and rehearse backup and restore. Local validation does not prove AWS, Atlas, CloudFront, or OIDC behavior.
